runs.question: How long do CFO Act agencies have to publish an AI strategy under the OMB AI memos?

answer.text:
Under the current OMB memo, CFO Act agencies have **180 days** from issuance to develop an AI strategy. Within 180 days of the issuance of this memorandum, each CFO Act agency must develop an AI Strategy for identifying and removing barriers to their responsible use of AI. That memo is M-25-21, issued April 3, 2025.

The earlier memo set a longer window. M-24-10 gave CFO Act agencies 365 days of the issuance of this memorandum to develop and publish the strategy. M-25-21 supersedes it: this memorandum rescinds and replaces Office of Management and Budget (0MB) Memorandum M-24-10. So the 180-day deadline governs.

Two scope notes from the documents: the strategy requirement applies to CFO Act agencies except for the Department of Defense, and does not apply to elements of the Intelligence Community. The M-25-21 strategy must also be published, and agencies must use the AI Strategies template, to be provided by 0MB, and make their AI Strategies publicly available.
